normalization_note: Leading theorem and shifted-Poisson law are prior results. Published amplitude agrees to printed precision with 9/4 times computed amplitude; no cause is claimed. Correct analytic normalization was already in Kang thesis.
limitations: All fixed orders mean J fixed; no convergent infinite series or growing-marker uniformity claimed.
Decimal comparisons are numerical regression, not interval certification.
Inverse constants and eventual threshold are not evaluated.
Formal singular expansion is an independent coefficient check, not a separate Delta-domain proof.
